description: This file defines the MyLeaveListController class, which extends LeaveListController and manages the rendering of a leave list view for the user's leave data within the OrangeHRM system. It prepares and sets a Vue component with leave-related properties for the front-end.

classes.name: MyLeaveListController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the user's leave list page, extending functionality from LeaveListController, and configuring the Vue component with leave data properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave list component with relevant data before rendering the view, including leave statuses, types, date ranges, and statuses.
